get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific business location.
get.description:
Returns the complete business profile including contact information,
address, and social media links. This information is used for customer
communications and service delivery.

Possible errors:
- NOT_FOUND if the business ID doesn't exist
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the business to retrieve
Required. Must be a valid business ID

post.summary: Lists business locations based on specified criteria.
post.description:
Results are paginated and filtered by company ID. This method is typically
used for business management and customer-facing location directories.

Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if pagination parameters are invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ListBusinessRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving business locations.

latitude.description: The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].

typeLatLng.description: An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this must conform to the WGS84 standard. Values must be within normalized ranges.

id.description: string, Unique identifier for the address.

address1.title:
string, Street address including house number and street name.
Example: "123 Main Street", "Unit 4B, 567 Park Avenue"

address2.title:
string, Additional address details like apartment, suite, or unit number.
Example: "Floor 3", "Building B"

city.title:
string, City or locality name.
Example: "San Francisco", "New York City"

state.title:
string, State, province, or region.
Example: "CA", "NY"

postalCode.title:
string, Postal or ZIP code.
Example: "94105", "10001"

country.title:
string, Country name or ISO country code.
Example: "US", "United States"

coordinate.description:
object(LatLng), Latitude and Longitude coordinate for mapping.
Latitude Range: -90 to 90. Longitude Range: -180 to 180.

type.title: enum(Type), represents the importance of the address

v1Address.description:
The address object represents a physical location used throughout the system.
It provides a standardized way to store and validate address information for
businesses, customers, and service locations. The address format follows
common postal standards and includes geocoding information for mapping.

v1AddressType.description:
- TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not intended for direct use. Indicates a system anomaly.
 - PRIMARY: Primary Address, which will be used as first address choice.
 - SECONDARY: Secondary Address, an optional address saved as back-up
v1AddressType.title:
Possible values are `primary`, `secondary`.
Type represents the importance of the address

id.title:
Unique identifier for the business location
Format: "bus_" followed by random characters

name.title:
Display name of the business location
Used in customer communications and UI

avatar.title:
URL to the business location's logo or image
Optional. Must be a valid HTTPS URL

phone.title:
Primary contact phone number
Format: E.164 format (e.g., +12125551234)

businessPhone.title:
Public business phone number
Format: E.164 format (e.g., +12125551234)

email.title:
Business contact email address
Format: Must be a valid email address

address.title:
Physical location details
Required for in-person services

website.title:
Business website URL
Optional. Must be a valid HTTPS URL

facebook.title:
Facebook page URL
Optional. Must be a valid Facebook page URL

instagram.title:
Instagram profile URL
Optional. Must be a valid Instagram profile URL

yelp.title:
Yelp business page URL
Optional. Must be a valid Yelp business URL

google.title:
Google Business Profile URL
Optional. Must be a valid Google Business URL

companyId.title:
ID of the parent company
Required. Must be a valid company ID

v1Business.description:
Business represents a physical or virtual location where services are provided.
Each business location operates under a parent company and maintains its own
staff, services, and operational settings. Business profiles include contact
information and social media presence for customer engagement.

pagination.title:
Pagination parameters for handling large result sets
Required to manage data volume efficiently

companyId.title:
ID of the company to list business locations for
Required to ensure businesses are accessed within proper context

v1ListBusinessRequest.description: ListBusinessRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving business locations.

nextPageToken.title:
Token for retrieving the next page of results
Empty if there are no more results

businesses.title:
List of business locations matching the request criteria
May be empty if no businesses match

v1ListBusinessResponse.description: ListBusinessResponse contains the paginated list of business locations.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.
